name: gkmur
description: Gabriel Murray's personal Claude skills marketplace

plugins.name: pretext-typography
plugins.description: Advanced web typography via @chenglou/pretext — drop caps, pull quotes, image flow-around, canvas/SVG text. Use when typography needs to flow around obstacles or do anything CSS can't.

plugins.name: moodboard
plugins.description: Pull visual inspiration from a local Pinterest mirror into a design brief. Curates 3 pin candidates with thumbnail previews, then extracts design DNA (palette, type, texture, composition, motion) into MOODBOARD.md as input for design-consultation, frontend-design, or design-shotgun. Local-only: depends on ~/wiki/pinterest/ and the qmd MCP.

plugins.name: session-state
plugins.description: Session continuity: the wrap-up skill writes a worktree-safe .claude/STATE.md whiteboard so the next session answers 'where were we?'. Pairs with the SessionStart auto-load hook.
